correspondence.note: The pressure identities (8.13), the zero auxiliary mean of the remainder, P ∈ S_α, p_m ∈ M_α, the divergence-free increment with Δγ = γd − A1 γd, ⟨Δγ⟩_Y = ⟨γd⟩_Y, Ψ∗ ∈ M_α and Δγ ∈ M_α are stated. For a general γd ∈ M_α, meanClass_streamBeta states only the unscaled β ∈ M_α. Δβ = −ε∂_Z Ψ∗ ∈ M_(α+1) follows by combining it with streamBeta_smul_direction and the ε band bound, the same three steps that meanClass_scaledTemporalStreamBeta carries out only for the temporal-update source; that combination is the reviewer's argument.
